title: Australian Amalgamated Terminals Pty Ltd (AAT) - proposed acquisition of Automotive and Ro-Ro Terminal at the Port of Fremantle
targets: Automotive and Ro-Ro Terminal at the Port of Fremantle

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed decision date of 26 February delayed.
Draft 87B undertaking proffered by AAT. ACCC commenced market inquiries.
Closing date for submissions relating to draft 87B undertaking.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.
